title: Code after return never runs
prompt: Run the starter as it is: "after" is never printed, because return ends the function at once. Fix the helper so it prints both words and still returns 1.
hints: Anything that must happen has to come before the return line.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
